research_question: Does the aggregate overlap count between the two immediately preceding main-number draws provide cutoff-safe context for next-draw number inclusion, sufficient to improve a deterministic three-line disjoint union18 portfolio over the exact geometry-matched null?
novelty_statement: One frozen three-state aggregate previous-two-draw overlap transition family. Unlike E053's candidate-specific two-draw membership state, E068 uses only the scalar intersection size of the two immediately preceding draws to condition the next-draw inclusion distribution. It is not a claim of statistical independence. It is distinct in feature definition from E049 sum/odd/low/consecutive draw state, E063 last-digit occupancy, E066 gap shape, E067 prime count, E050 neighbor distance, E048 bonus transition, and B-model selectors. One estimator, one portfolio selector, one historical evaluation; no variants or tuning.
training_cutoff_rule: For target t, use only draws 1..t-1. For each historical transition outcome u=3..t-1, use the overlap-count state of draws u-2 and u-1 as the feature and the six main numbers of draw u as the outcome. Score target t from draws t-2 and t-1, then add target t only after scoring.

feature_definition.source: The two immediately preceding draws' six main numbers only; bonus numbers are excluded.
feature_definition.overlap_count: Count the shared main numbers between draws t-2 and t-1.

state_components.overlap_count_bin: 0 if overlap_count==0; 1 if overlap_count==1; 2 if overlap_count>=2

feature_definition.distance: Hamming distance across the one frozen categorical overlap-count component.
feature_definition.transition_history: For each historical outcome round u=3..t-1, use the overlap-count state of draws u-2 and u-1 as the feature and the six main numbers of draw u as the outcome. Score target t from draws t-2 and t-1, then add target t only after scoring.
feature_definition.candidate_universe: All integers 1..45 are scored for every target.

estimator.conditional_count: Weighted count of each main number in historical transition outcomes.
estimator.global_rate: Count of each main number in draws 1..t-1 divided by t-1.

portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.
portfolio.selection: Three sequential calls to the unchanged E045 choose_disjoint_ticket selector, passing the E068 score as both role_score and global_score; remove selected numbers after each line.
portfolio.line_order: Line 1, then line 2, then line 3, each selected from the remaining unused numbers.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line-incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.

prospective_confirmation.readiness_rule: Even if the historical gate passes, do not create STRICT_PASS_READY or release purchase lines until the policy owner formally predeclares the prospective minimum target count and completion rule.

promotion_rule: Evaluate this single preregistered axis once. No variants, threshold changes, alpha changes, block-length changes, comparator changes, or parameter search after observing results. Historical failure remains failure. Historical pass alone cannot create purchase readiness because prospective confirmation is required and currently unspecified.
preregistration_hashing: This preregistration is committed before E068 outcome statistics are computed; the frozen runner, test, workflow, E045 base helper, and three-line policy blobs are checked before execution.
